test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('w', toString(number * 8 + i)), range(8)), ' ') FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_block_size = 1000000, max_insert_threads = 8
